name: butter_cash_comparison
description: Compare cash accounts against a baseline using dated bank terms and posted cash flows. Local process tool; no network or bank access.
stdout: JSON comparison unless --format csv or --output is specified
stderr: JSON error with error and message fields

exitCodes.3: no eligible banks; report still emitted

xml: banks/scenario --format xml serializes validated YAML/JSON/XML into schema 3.2 XML
audit: Local evidence/unknown/conflict audit; does not reopen URLs or certify terms
provenance: CLI includes SHA-256 hashes of both exact input files.
sideEffects: Only requested local output files and their parent directories are written.
features: Nine feature categories, source-scoped claims and a prioritized research queue; local files only.

verifications.effect: Inspect personal checks and evidence changes; no mutation of bank data or rankings

reviews.description: Local attributed customer reports, source context, curation coverage and manual checks; no scenario or network required. Not a bank safety score.
